items.summary: Update the Leaderboard tab UI to include two additional buttons, “Remove Win” and “Remove Loss”, displayed immediately next to the existing “Win” and “Loss” add buttons in the date-selection action row.

Implement remove-win/remove-loss behavior in the frontend so that clicking “Remove Win” or “Remove Loss” decrements the corresponding count by 1 for the selected day, never allowing the day’s wins or losses to go below 0, and shows success/error toasts consistent with the existing add-win/add-loss flows.

Add React Query mutations for removing a daily win and removing a daily loss that call new backend actor methods, and invalidate the same query keys as the existing recordDailyWin/recordDailyLoss mutations (callerStats, leaderboard, callerMatchHistory).

Extend the Motoko backend to support decrementing a caller’s daily wins/losses for a given day (selected in the UI), updating the same underlying storage used by recordDailyWin/recordDailyLoss, never allowing wins/losses to go below 0, and recomputing overall stats afterward so the leaderboard reflects the change.
